scientific_investigation_of_low_recall.geometrical_factor: Raw Level-1 GRD imagery in slant-range geometry (CRS: None) with 98.4° ascending orbital tilt; spatial misregistration relative to WGS84 vector polygons without full Range-Doppler Terrain Correction.
scientific_investigation_of_low_recall.physical_factor: C-band (5.6 cm) microwave pulses reflect off dense forest and elephant grass canopies, causing 1,188.15 km² of false negatives.
scientific_investigation_of_low_recall.nisar_hypothesis: Presents a scientifically motivated hypothesis: NASA-ISRO NISAR L-band (24 cm) radar is theoretically designed to penetrate vegetative canopies and exploit double-bounce scattering to detect sub-canopy flooding.
